Tosafot on Bava Batra 146a:11:1.hebrew: תרגמה רבא בייבא - פי' רבינו שמואל: דה"ה דהוה מצי לשנויי: "לא, והוא דבלו". ור"י אומר: דבשלמא בברייתא מיירי בבלו, אלא מתני' דלא מיירי בבלו — לא מיתוקמא בבלו:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 146a:11:1.english: Rava interpreted it as referring to bayiva - Rabbeinu Shmuel explained: The same [reasoning applies], that [the Gemara] could have answered: "No, [the gifts are not worn out], and [the ruling applies] only where they wore out." But Rabbi Yitzchak says: It is well in the case of the baraita, which deals with [gifts] that wore out; but the Mishnah, which does not deal with [gifts] that wore out, cannot be established as [referring to gifts] that wore out.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 146a:7:1.hebrew: סבלונות העשוין ליבלות אין נגבין - והא דתנא: "מרובין שתביא עמה מבית אביה לבית בעלה — הרי אלו נגבין", היינו אין עשוין לבלות, ו"מועטין" היינו עשוין לבלות. א"נ, במועטות בעינן דוקא שאין עשוי לבלות, אבל במרובים אפי' בבלות נמי נגבין:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 146a:7:1.english: Gifts [of clothing] that are made to wear out are not collected - And as for that which was taught, "Large [gifts] that she brings with her from her father's house to her husband's house — these are collected," that refers to [gifts] that are not made to wear out, and "small [gifts]" refers to those that are made to wear out. Alternatively, with small [gifts] we require specifically that they not be made to wear out, but with large ones, even [gifts that are made to] wear out are also collected.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 146a:9:1.hebrew: איבעיא להו מהו שתשלש - פי' אמילתא דרבא קאי, דאמר: דוקא אכל דינר, אבל פחות מדינר לא. וקא אמר: אם אכל פחות מדינר, מהו שתגבה לפי מה שאכל? אם אכל חצי דינר, תגבה החצי. ולישנא דתשלש כמו "משלשין בממון ואין משלשין במכות" (מכות דף ה.). מ"ר:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 146a:9:1.english: "They inquired: Can she teshalesh?" - Explanation: [The question] refers to Rava's statement, who said that [the rule applies] only if he ate a dinar's worth, but [if he ate] less than a dinar, [it does] not. And [the Gemara] is asking: If he ate less than a dinar's worth, can she collect in proportion to what he ate? If he ate half a dinar's worth, may she collect half? And the language of teshalesh is like [the phrase] "we apportion [meshalshin] in monetary cases, but we do not apportion in cases of lashes" (Makkot 5a). [This is from] Rabbeinu Meir.
